name: ui
description: Shared presentation kit: theme, copy, templates and the data screens other extensions contribute, for every extension page.

theme.description: Brand and design tokens for every page the kit renders. Values are checked against a narrow grammar at activation, so a theme never carries CSS syntax, URLs or markup.

name.description: Brand name shown in the page header; plain text.

logo.description: Local absolute path of the header logo image, for example /public/logo.svg; no scheme, query or traversal.

favicon.description: Local absolute path of the favicon; same rules as logo.

backTo.description: Same-site path (optional query) the header links back to, for example /; never a scheme or protocol-relative URL.

dark.description: Dark-scheme colour overrides, applied by media query and by the dark class.

colors.description: Light-scheme colour overrides by semantic shadcn/ui token; unset tokens keep the kit defaults.

font.description: Plain font-family list, for example Inter, sans-serif; no url() or escapes.

languages.description: Language tags the site offers (default [en]); any other than en needs a copy directory with <copy>/<tag>.json.

copy.description: Relative directory under ui/ holding <locale>.json catalogues that override or translate catalogue entries by id, for example ui/copy.

templates.description: Relative directory under ui/ whose <name>.html files shadow a kit or extension template of that name, for example ui/templates.

stylesheet.description: Project CSS under ui/: a path is appended after the kit stylesheet; {file, replace: true} replaces it. Script, javascript:, expression() and @import are refused.

file.description: Relative path of the CSS file under ui/ (at most 512 KiB).

replace.description: true: serve this file instead of the kit stylesheet; default false (append).

oneOf.description: Project-relative module path; its default export is the hook.

source.description: Project-relative path of the trusted hook module, resolved like a function route source and re-imported on each activation.

export.description: Named export to call (default: the module default export).

sandbox.description: Schema-valid but refused at activation when true: extension hooks run trusted, in-process, and are never sandboxed.

sandboxReason.description: Reviewer note recorded with a sandbox choice; it grants nothing.

transformView.description: Filter hook: Runs before a named kit template renders and returns the view model to render.

oneOf.description: Project-relative module path; its default export is the hook.

source.description: Project-relative path of the trusted hook module, resolved like a function route source and re-imported on each activation.

export.description: Named export to call (default: the module default export).

sandbox.description: Schema-valid but refused at activation when true: extension hooks run trusted, in-process, and are never sandboxed.

sandboxReason.description: Reviewer note recorded with a sandbox choice; it grants nothing.

transformPage.description: Filter hook: Runs before the shared page layout renders and may change its title, layout, navigation, account menu or flash message.

hooks.description: Trusted project filter hooks by name ({source, export} or a bare module path) that adjust a view model or the page shell before rendering; sandbox: true is refused.

hooks.name: transformView
hooks.description: Runs before a named kit template renders and returns the view model to render.

template.description: Name of the template about to render, for example layout.

view.description: The view model; return it, changed or not, as the model to render.

hooks.name: transformPage
hooks.description: Runs before the shared page layout renders and may change its title, layout, navigation, account menu or flash message.

page.description: The page options (title, layout, navigation, account menu, flash); return the options to render.

authoring.description: Keep the site as one application: customize the installed UI in the project and keep each extension's behavior in its package. Use a new extension only for a capability the installed extensions do not provide.

surfaces.name: theme
surfaces.description: Set brand name, local assets, semantic light/dark colours, radius and font in extensions.ui.config.theme.

surfaces.name: copy
surfaces.description: Override or translate catalogue entries without copying a screen.

surfaces.name: templates
surfaces.description: Override only the screen or shared partial whose structure must change; doctor reports view-model drift.

surfaces.name: stylesheet
surfaces.description: Append project CSS after the shared stylesheet; use semantic shadcn tokens and existing ui-* component classes.

surfaces.name: transformView
surfaces.description: Add computed project data to a named view immediately before its template renders.

surfaces.name: transformPage
surfaces.description: Customize the shared page shell, navigation, account menu and flash immediately before layout rendering.

agent.description: Local, revision-pinned references for agents configuring the UI extension.

references.name: UI extension guide
references.description: Configuration and theming guidance for the UI extension; ends with the generated field reference for every configuration key.
